Two women, an African American receptionist and a Jewish chemist, were in the line to check out in the grocery store. The African American receptionist used a SNAP card to pay for her groceries, while the other woman pulled out black Amex card. Which person receives government benefits?
A. The African American receptionist
B. Undetermined
C. The Jewish chemist
